recognize_zh: 紅色箭頭指出大型細胞，核大且染色質推向核膜邊緣，中央有類似核仁、玻璃狀的核內包涵體，並有核中央透明化；這就是 Parvovirus B19 感染的巨大前紅血球母細胞，而周圍幾乎看不到成熟中的紅系細胞。
features: Scattered giant proerythroblasts (red arrows) markedly larger than surrounding hematopoietic cells
Large nuclei with central clearing and chromatin margination
Paucity of maturing erythroid precursors in a cellular marrow
Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages with golden-brown pigment
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a cellular marrow with scattered giant proerythroblasts, highlighted by arrows. These cells have large nuclei with marginated chromatin, central nuclear clearing, and glassy nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusions. Maturing erythroid precursors are sparse, and scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia; confirmation with parvovirus immunostain, in situ hybridization, or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows many erythroid precursors with open sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, not isolated giant proerythroblasts with viral inclusions and erythroid depletion.
Acute erythroid leukemia has sheets of atypical proerythroblasts with p53 overexpression rather than scattered proerythroblasts in an erythroid-poor marrow.
Megakaryocytes have lobated nuclei and CD61 expression, and Hodgkin cells have CD30/CD15 expression and lack intranuclear viral inclusions.
CMV causes enlarged endothelial or stromal cells with owl-eye inclusions and cytoplasmic inclusions, confirmed by CMV immunostain rather than parvovirus markers.
